review_description: The business's that came through solar quotes all turned up & were all super knowledgeable (as they should be). All had a different piece of info that I didn't know about. The business I ended up going through went that extra step & sent out their sparky who was the only person that asked to see my electricity bill to see what my usage was & confirmed the set I'm getting will be more than enough. This was great piece of mind when he went through all the calculations with me.
